content: We incorporate QC information into the QA process by implementing a variant of a query expansion model BIBREF50 . Specifically, for a given {question, QC_label} pair, we expand the question text by concatenating the definition text of the question classification label to the start of the question. We use of the top predicted question classification label for each question. Because QC labels are hierarchical, we append the label definition text for each level of the label INLINEFORM0 . An exampe of this process is shown in Table TABREF23 .
